description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Names that granted Certificate of Exemption ( Electricity)
categorisation: This gazette contains a legal notice issued under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (amended) regarding the issuance of certificates of exemption from licensing requirements. It involves regulatory matters and statutory instruments, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters.
